source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.7.4, printed page 36.

blocks.text: Hund ka rule batata hai ke barabar energy ke orbitals, misal ke taur par teen p orbitals px, py aur pz, mein electrons kaise bharein. Agar teen electrons teen p orbitals mein rakhne hon to do mumkin tareeqe hain: sab kam orbitals mein jure spins ke saath thunse hue, ya har orbital mein ek, ek jaise spin ke saath. Hund ka rule faisla karta hai.

blocks.title: Hund ka rule
blocks.text: Jab degenerate orbitals dastiyab hon aur un mein do se zyada electrons rakhne hon, to unhen ek hi orbital mein ulte spins ke bajaye alag alag orbitals mein ek jaise spin ke saath rakha jana chahiye.
To teen p orbitals mein teen electrons bharne ka sahi tareeqa woh hai jis mein har orbital mein ek ek electron ho, mutawazi (parallel) spins ke saath.

blocks.prompt: Oxygen ke 2p subshell (chaar 2p electrons) ka orbital diagram alfaz mein banayein aur batayein ke har khasoosiyat kis qaide par chalti hai.
blocks.explanation: Teen khane px, py, pz. Pehle Hund ke rule se har khane mein ek oopar ka teer jata hai, jo teen mutawazi spins deta hai. Chauthe electron ko phir jora banana hai, aur woh Pauli ke principle se px mein neeche ke teer ke saath dakhil hota hai, pehle se maujood ke ulat. Nateeja ek jura khana aur do ek ek electron wale khane.

items: Hund ka rule: degenerate orbitals mein dakhil hone wale electrons jora banane se pehle alag alag orbitals mein ek jaise spin ke saath baithte hain; teen p electrons px, py aur pz mein ek ek jate hain.
